dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A century-old method, you say? But that's nothing since the fae live for hundreds of years anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Ryabov
dialogues.text: I... So you know, huh? Ha, my bad, my bad. I thought you were new to Snezhnaya, my friend. I thought you were a tourist who knew nothing about fae.

dialogues.speaker: Ryabov
dialogues.text: *Sigh* It's hard to do business in this economy. I used to sell my wares like every other fellow out there, but many first-time visitors to Snezhnaya shied away the moment they saw that I'm not human.

dialogues.speaker: Ryabov
dialogues.text: But since a fae has got to eat... I started to use this gimmick. And surprisingly, it worked, and worked really well, in fact.

dialogues.speaker: Ryabov
dialogues.text: I'm well over a hundred years old anyway, so it's not like I'm lying or anything, right?

dialogues.speaker: Ryabov
dialogues.text: You seem to know what's what, so free glass of liquor on me the next time you drop by!
